retake.waitBetweenAttempts: Varies; applicant may re-test after further study

gdl.permitHoldingPeriod: 6 months violation-free before the intermediate license
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving midnight-5 a.m. (intermediate license), with limited exceptions
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 9 months (or until 18), no passengers except immediate family unless a licensed driver 20+ with 2 years' experience is present

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and legal presence (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Maine residency (for a REAL ID)
process.realIdNotes: Maine issues REAL ID-compliant licenses (marked with a star). Bring one proof of identity/legal presence, one proof of Social Security Number, and two proofs of Maine residency. A standard (non-REAL ID) license is also available.
process.licenseFee: $30 standard Class C license for applicants under 65 (6-year term); $20 at age 65+ (4-year term)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses (free screening at the exam)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Accumulation of 12 or more demerit points within 12 months may lead to suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow to a safe speed if you cannot, for stopped emergency, maintenance, and service vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph on posted interstate segments (unless otherwise posted)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 mph in a school zone during posted hours or when the zone is in use
